context: Handling bulk requests safely: setup, rate limits, open-access checks, key handling and honest labelling of abstract-based analysis.

checklist.name: Environment set up first
checklist.description: The agent creates the venv and installs dependencies from requirements.txt before the first run, following the setup reference.

checklist.name: MCP check before script
checklist.description: The agent checks for a PubTator or PubMed MCP before falling back to the script.

checklist.name: Delay between batch calls
checklist.description: The agent adds a short delay (for example a sleep) between the 40 metadata fetches rather than firing them back to back.

checklist.name: Rate-limit awareness stated
checklist.description: The agent mentions the 3 requests per second limit without an API key.

checklist.name: Single 30 s retry on 429
checklist.description: If a 429 occurs the agent waits 30 s and retries once, without looping.

checklist.name: API key not hardcoded
checklist.description: The agent refuses to write the key into the script and uses the PUBMED_API_KEY environment variable or a gitignored dotenv file.

checklist.name: PMC open-access checked before download
checklist.description: The agent confirms PMC availability and open-access status for each PMID before calling download.

checklist.name: Non-open-access papers handled
checklist.description: The agent reports PMIDs that are not open access instead of assuming the download will work.

checklist.name: Analysis labelled abstract-based
checklist.description: The agent labels analyze output as abstract-based and does not mark papers as fully reviewed.

checklist.name: Full text recommended
checklist.description: The agent recommends obtaining the full text for any paper that will be relied on in the systematic review.

checklist.name: No automatic triage
checklist.description: The agent does not hand papers to triage-paper without asking the user first.
